response.rationale: R3 is best because the exophytic verrucous clinical morphology plus papillary fronds with fibrovascular cores lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and lack of atypia fit a benign squamous papilloma. R2 has overlapping goblet-cell-containing fronds but lacks the inverted/endophytic growth expected for inverted papilloma. R4 is contradicted by the explicit absence of cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures.

rejected.why: Its only raw support is the exophytic verrucous appearance, which is outweighed by the same histology excluding cytologic atypia and atypical mitotic figures; verrucous carcinoma would require those features or invasion.
